title: yummy sour mexican mushrooms toast
description: A paleo-friendly Mexican dish featuring sour, creamy mushrooms on toasted bread, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add 1/2 tsp of oil to the skillet and sauté the mushrooms until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the garlic powder, cumin, and chili powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the mushrooms for another 2-3 minutes, until they are tender.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until they are lightly browned.
Mix the mashed avocado, sour cream, lime juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl until smooth.
To assemble the toast, spread a tablespoon of the avocado-sour cream mixture on each bread slice.
Top each bread slice with a portion of the sautéed mushrooms.
